abstract: Serum alpha-fetoprotein from 146 patients with hepatocellular carcinoma, other malignancies, and benign liver diseases, was fractionated by lectin-affinity electrophoresis coupled with our sensitive detection method of antibody-affinity blotting. Compared with chronic hepatitis and liver cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma was characterized by the increase in proportions of lentil lectin A-reactive alpha-fetoprotein-L3 and erythroagglutinating phytohemagglutinin-reactive alpha-fetoprotein-P4; the yolk sac tumor was characterized by the increase of concanavalin A-nonreactive alpha-fetoprotein-C1, lentil lectin-A-weakly reactive alpha-fetoprotein-L2, erythroagglutinating phytohemagglutinin-strongly reactive alpha-fetoprotein-P5, and Allomyrina dichotoma lectin-nonreactive, slow-migrating alpha-fetoprotein-Als; and gastrointestinal tumors were characterized by alpha-fetoprotein-C1, alpha-fetoprotein-L2, alpha-fetoprotein-L3, alpha-fetoprotein-P5 and Allomyrina dichotoma-nonreactive alpha-fetoprotein-A1. By combined evaluation of alpha-fetoprotein-L3 and alpha-fetoprotein-P4, hepatocellular carcinoma was discriminated from chronic hepatitis and liver cirrhosis with a sensitivity of 97% at a specificity of 99.7%. Because the alpha-fetoprotein level of the studied cases ranged from 60-1,500,000 ng/mL (60-1,500,000 micrograms/L), mostly greater than 200 ng/mL (200 micrograms/L), additional patients with lower levels of alpha-fetoprotein [16-177 ng/mL (16-177 micrograms/L) for 16 cases of hepatocellular carcinoma with liver cirrhosis and 28-185 ng/mL (28-185 micrograms/L) for 17 cases of liver cirrhosis alone] were analyzed for alpha-fetoprotein-L3 and alpha-fetoprotein-P4. The resulting sensitivity for combined evaluation was still as high as 88% at the same high specificity of 99.7%, indicating that the simultaneous analysis of alpha-fetoprotein-L3 and alpha-fetoprotein-P4 is effective in monitoring the evolution of hepatocellular carcinoma in cirrhotic patients.
abstract_ja: 肝細胞癌、他の悪性腫瘍、良性肝疾患の患者146例の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を、レクチンアフィニティー電気泳動と抗体アフィニティーブロッティングを組み合わせた高感度検出法により分画した。慢性肝炎および肝硬変と比較して、肝細胞癌ではレンズマメレクチンA反応性AFP-L3およびエリスロアグルチニン型植物性赤血球凝集素反応性AFP-P4の割合が増加していることが特徴であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍では、コンカナバリンA非反応性AFP-C1、レンズマメレクチンA弱反応性AFP-L2、エリスロアグルチニン型植物性赤血球凝集素強反応性AFP-P5、そしてAllomyrina dichotoma レクチン非反応性の泳動の遅いAFP-Alsの増加が特徴であった。消化管腫瘍ではAFP-C1、AFP-L2、AFP-L3、AFP-P5およびAllomyrina dichotoma非反応性AFP-A1が特徴であった。AFP-L3とAFP-P4を併用して評価することにより、肝細胞癌は特異度99.7%で感度97%をもって慢性肝炎および肝硬変と鑑別された。研究対象症例のAFP値は60〜1,500,000 ng/mLの範囲にあり、大部分は200 ng/mLを超えていた。このため、低値のAFP症例（肝硬変を伴う肝細胞癌16例では16〜177 ng/mL、肝硬変のみの17例では28〜185 ng/mL）を追加解析したところ、同じ高い特異度99.7%で併用評価の感度は88%と依然として高かった。これは、肝硬変患者における肝細胞癌の経過観察において、AFP-L3とAFP-P4の同時解析が有効であることを示している。
